test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 19 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
A, B, C, D, N, O and P are sitting in a straight line, facing the north.

Only N sits to the left of P. Only four people sit between N and A. Only B sits between O and C, and O is not an immediate neighbour of A.

Who sits at the extreme right of the line?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, N, O and P are sitting in a straight line facing north.

Only N sits to the left of P.

Only four people sit between N and A.

Only B sits between O and C, and O is not an immediate neighbour of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b3d33f6c25a68bdd08848d2928bd378b2194da7ec93d3081747be1ed18b395e.png] 

Extreme right end = position 7 = D

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2**.
